name: Structure tests around one observable contract
statement: Name each test for one observable behavior, arrange only the state needed for that behavior, exercise the public contract, and assert both the result and material persisted or emitted effects.
rationale: Contract-focused tests diagnose regressions better than implementation-coupled tests. Quality Studio tests use isolated repository fixtures and independently verify persisted metadata and hashes.

badExample.code:
[Fact]
public async Task EverythingWorks() { /* many unrelated actions and assertions */ }

history.change: Initial test-structure rule grounded in Quality Studio's isolated xUnit contract tests.
